title: OOXML (Office Open XML) signature
summary: Modern Microsoft Office files (.docx, .xlsx, .pptx) are ZIP archives containing XML parts. The magic is the standard ZIP signature 0x50 0x4B 0x03 0x04; the content type is determined by [Content_Types].xml inside.
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: Same ZIP magic as any .zip file (50 4B 03 04).
Distinguish from generic ZIP by the presence of [Content_Types].xml and word/document.xml (or xl/workbook.xml, ppt/presentation.xml).
OOXML is a zipped collection of XML parts with relationships (.rels files).
Macro-enabled variants use .docm/.xlsm/.pptm and contain vbaProject.bin.
